semantic_reversion_rule: Restore each inherited addon-owned value for gui.jei.category.craftingTable from the validated G3 Minecraft 1.9 resource because the target English value is again exactly Crafting Table.
upstream_supplement_rule: Start from the exact G4 supplement, remove keys absent from the 1.10 English target, then restore any addon-owned changed-semantic key from G3. Existing JEI 3.7.1 upstream keys must never be emitted by the addon.

special_cases.haw_US: New Minecraft 1.10 primary language selected by policy. Use an explicit complete English fallback because reliable technical Hawaiian translation is not guaranteed in this pass.
special_cases.mn_MN: New Minecraft 1.10 primary language selected by policy. Use an explicit complete English fallback because reliable technical Mongolian translation is not guaranteed in this pass.
special_cases.de_AT: New Minecraft 1.10 language code but deferred as a regional German variant.
special_cases.swg_de: New Minecraft 1.10 language code identified as Oschtallgaierisch and deferred as a regional German/Swabian variety.
special_cases.ko_KR: Restore gui.jei.category.craftingTable from G3: 제작대. Do not retain the G4 generic-Crafting value 제작.
special_cases.ru_RU: JEI 3.7.1 upstream owns every selected normal key except config.jei.advanced.colorSearchEnabled and its comment; supplement exactly those two.
special_cases.fr_FR: The two hideLaggyModels keys no longer exist in the target, leaving only jei.tooltip.cheat.mode missing upstream.
special_cases.zh_CN: The two hideLaggyModels keys no longer exist in the target, leaving only jei.tooltip.cheat.mode missing upstream.

debug_policy: The three upstream DEBUG description keys remain in English for all complete addon locales.
fallback_policy: Retain the ten existing documented complete English fallbacks and add haw_US plus mn_MN as two new explicit complete English fallbacks. Prefer these documented fallbacks over invented low-confidence translations.
